answer: Agent networks managing terrace microgrids can curb Sybil attacks with hardware-rooted attestation. Each epoch, a node boots a measured kernel and produces a silicon-signed quote binding its ephemeral key and unique chip ID to a public randomness beacon. Peers validate the vendor certificate chain and allow one registration per chip ID, forcing attackers to procure distinct physical silicon per fake identity. Still, hardware side-channel leaks can expose endorsement keys and allow cloning.
